reviewers: GPT-6 Astra, maximum reasoning, independent read-only audit

policy.direction: rmux is a pinned comparison reference. Implement focused Linux psX behavior on the native Baikal baseline using upstream interfaces and recorded hardware contracts. Do not bulk-import the comparison target.
policy.lineage: Retained existing code and equivalent known fixes preserve their source provenance. The native baseline still has recorded inherited adaptations; this audit is not a clean-room or complete rewrite claim.
policy.frozen_imports: All 294 patches and 9 reference files remain unchanged.
policy.limits: Broad integrity and engineering audit, not exhaustive line-by-line certification of vendor code, a complete replacement of294patches, or hardware acceptance. No console operation/publication.

coverage.normalization: Keep diff content/context; remove mail metadata, index hashes and hunk line ranges.

implementation_sequence: Overridable native platform defaults and bounded error/lifetime paths
ICC transaction ownership, interrupt bounds and shutdown lifecycle
AHCI/USB/SDIO error handling with artifact-specific hardware evidence
Optional LED/buzzer/thermal/CPU controls as separate capabilities
Aeolia/Belize and PS5 qualification separately; no universal binary claim

findings.description: Per-setting runtime PS4 defaults equivalent to pci=nocrs/intremap=off; explicit options override. Not a confirmed diagnosis of third-party boot failures.
findings.verification: Astra and primary source review, actual-function CPU tests, full series application and affected object compilation

findings.description: APCIE and BPCIE not-ready paths now release their command mutex. The comparison target already had this fix.
findings.verification: Astra and primary source review; actual-function lock/error tests and object compilation

findings.description: Bound stabilization, tick alignment and 1024-tick waits while preserving native register setup and existing fallback.
findings.verification: Astra and primary source review; actual-function unstable/stopped/wrapped timer tests and object compilation

findings.description: Free rejected PS4 connectors and pair DP AUX registration/unregistration without replacing PR3 property handling.
findings.verification: Astra and primary source review and object compilation

findings.description: Initialize UART slots to negative sentinels before any cleanup. Baikal hardware results do not qualify the Aeolia removal path.
findings.verification: Astra and primary source review and object compilation

findings.description: Correct proc prefix/payload accounting and bound firmware config tokens/item indexes before fixed-field copies. Vendor-origin defects, not rmux-authored deltas.
findings.verification: Astra and primary source review, actual-function boundary tests and complete mt76x8 subtree compilation
findings.limits: Bounds encoded lengths and fixed-field copies, not complete token rejection. Caller narrows token sizes to CHAR before validation; e.g.257bytes becomes1. Existing numeric conversion, oversized proc-write truncation and partial local-config updates remain.

findings.description: Original psX0175 was generated against Baikal layout and failed applying to the rmux-based comparison target. Original file retained; adapted context has its own identity.
findings.verification: Primary reproduced failure and full corrected176patch application

findings.description: Native dev3 integrates suds-mcduff PR #4 v2 atomic final power-off sender with a maintainer pre-mutation guard for reboot_force and outstanding replies. Original author/sign-off retained. Reboot, timed-out reply recovery and the comparison shutdown path remain separate; no new hardware acceptance.
findings.verification: Primary and Astra maximum-reasoning source audit, corrected patch application, and actual-sender CPU regression: original fails pending/forced cases and corrected sender passes. Affected object compilation is recorded in native target validation.

findings.description: AHCI ignores apcie/bpcie IRQ allocation failures and frees a hardcoded IRQ count. Add error propagation and allocation-count bookkeeping with failure cleanup.
findings.verification: Astra review plus primary direct source inspection

findings.description: Shared ioctl staging buffer is not serialized across copy-command-copy; requested response size can expose stale bytes beyond actual response. Design private per-call buffers/transaction locking, actual-length validation and teardown synchronization.
findings.verification: Astra review plus primary direct source inspection

findings.description: Interrupt loops continue on status bits beyond the SEND/ACK bits they handle. Bound processing and preserve the hardware acknowledgement order.
findings.verification: Astra review plus primary source inspection

findings.description: DP status bypass uses device!=0x9920 and therefore includes ordinary AMD GPUs. Scope any replacement to the actual PS4 ASIC/bridge.
findings.verification: Astra review plus primary direct source inspection

findings.description: Baikal detection uses pci_get_device before PCI enumeration in the AMD IOMMU detection path. Establish an early-safe platform discriminator before choosing hardware policy.
findings.verification: Astra review plus primary direct call-site inspection

findings.description: get_tx_power adapter misroutes link/output arguments; native already has a corrected adapter and comparison leaf currently returns EINVAL.
findings.verification: Astra independent source review; do not adopt as an implemented fix or hardware conclusion

findings.description: Mailbox register operations lack whole-transaction serialization. Keep experimental until independently designed.
findings.verification: Astra independent source review; do not adopt as an implemented fix or hardware conclusion

findings.description: ICC/SMBus EDID helpers need complete-response length checks and EDID cache cleanup.
findings.verification: Astra independent source review; do not adopt as an implemented fix or hardware conclusion

findings.description: Cached purple state can become stale when a later initcall programs blue.
findings.verification: Astra independent source review; do not adopt as an implemented fix or hardware conclusion

findings.description: Forced GEM unpin changes all AMDGPU objects; broad scope is verified, but a specific caused failure is not. Investigate ownership rather than suppressing warnings.
findings.verification: Astra independent source review; do not adopt as an implemented fix or hardware conclusion

findings.verification: Astra independent source review; do not adopt as an implemented fix or hardware conclusion
